title: Reserve persistent free-native banner space without loading an ad SDK
prompt: Read README.md, AGENTS.md, docs/SWARM_BENCHMARK.md, docs/DESIGN_RECONCILIATION.md, docs/PILOT100_READY.md and your frozen export contract in docs/PILOT100_UI_CONTRACTS.md before coding. Implement only your owned leaf module using installed React/TypeScript/testing dependencies. Export the exact named component and readonly props/types from index.tsx; keep module-local styles and tests inside that directory. Do not import an unmerged A/B task, edit App.tsx/shared barrels/manifests/task metadata or silently change another contract. This is controlled recipient-safe presentation, not an authority or complete application. Authority state/capabilities and semantic callbacks are supplied; no Firebase/native/store/network calls, secret caching, clock-driven game transitions, asset generation or fabricated success. Use original neutral-frost chrome, semantic HTML/keyboard access and honest unavailable media/provider states. Overlay leaves supply content to the separately composed modal host; do not claim global focus blocking in a content-only leaf. No commits, pushes, PRs, child agents, credentials, cloud deployment or budget changes. Preserve concise handoff, observed validation/failures and unknown costs under the benchmark policy. Implement an accessible fixed bottom banner-dock frame with safe-area padding. Web/Remove Ads occupies no ad height; eligible native free states retain supplied reserved height through loading/failure so layout does not jump. Actual ad surface is separately mounted by the future reviewed native adapter. Own only apps/client/src/pilot100/banner-dock/; provide index.tsx exporting BannerDock, BannerDockProps and any named local types documented for B046. This task consumes part of A089; do not double-count it as a second implementation of that broad work. Run scoped React tests/lint/typecheck and node tools/benchmark-pilot.mjs --profile full; report actual results and unresolved application integration.
acceptance: Native free loading,loaded,failed and unavailable states keep the same supplied reserved height.
Web and adsRemoved states suppress ad reservation and show no fake advertisement.
Invalid negative/nonfinite height cannot cover controls; dock does not call SDKs or request targeting data.
Exact frozen export/readonly props are implemented and scoped lint/typecheck/meaningful React tests plus node tools/benchmark-pilot.mjs --profile full pass; only owned files change.
